{{Short description| Australian businesspeople (born 1960)}} {{EngvarB|date=September 2014}} {{Use dmy dates|date=January 2021}} {{Infobox person | name = Kevin Bermeister | birth_date = 1960 | birth_place = South Africa | occupation = entrepreneur | known_for = [[Ozisoft]] (founder)
Brilliant Digital Entertainment Inc. (founder & CEO) | awards = Yeshiva Center Leadership in Philanthropy }} '''Kevin Bermeister''' (born 1960 in South Africa{{cite web |title=Burmeister, Kevin |url=https://www.esearch.net.au/cgi-bin/eCasual |website=esearch Person Name Search |access-date=7 April 2021}}) is an entrepreneur that has developed several businesses in the computer, multimedia and Internet industries. He is a technology innovator, real estate investor, philanthropist, and the founder, chairman and CEO of [[Brilliant Digital Entertainment]] Inc. (BDE).{{Cite web |title=Brilliant Digital is the leading online distributor of licensed digital content. |url=http://www.brilliantdigital.com/ |access-date=2022-06-09 |website=www.brilliantdigital.com}} Bermeister is a founding investor in a number of successful technology and real estate ventures including [[Skype]].[http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/sydney-news/company-sale-took-the-fun-out/story-e6freuzi-1226355284968 Company Sale Took The Fun Out] ''The Daily Telegraph'' {{dead link|date=May 2023}} ==Career== In 1983, Bermeister established [[Ozisoft]], one of the first interactive multimedia companies. By 1990, Ozisoft was Australia's largest [[video games]] distributor. In 1992, Bermeister and Mark Dyne successfully led a management buyout, together with [[Sega]] Enterprises, to form [[Namco Bandai Partners|Sega Ozisoft Pty Limited]] representing exclusively the world's largest video game publisher. In 1994, Bermeister and his property consortium Jacfun{{cite news| url=http://www.smh.com.au/nsw/sega-world-says-it-was-deceived-over-office-space-20110221-1b2o5.html | work=The Sydney Morning Herald | date=22 February 2011 | title=Sega World says it was deceived over office space}} negotiated rights to property at Sydney's [[Darling Harbour]] and established the interactive [[Sega World Sydney]] amusement park, operated through a joint venture including shareholders Sega Enterprises Japan, [[Mitsubishi]] Corp. and [[Mitsui]] Corp. Bermeister founded Brilliant Digital Entertainment Inc.[http://www.docstoc.com/docs/21719483/Public-Offering-Registration---BRILLIANT-DIGITAL-ENTERTAINMENT-INC---9-17-1996 Public Offering Registration. Brilliant Digital Entertainment Inc. 17 September 1996]docstoc.com {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120121004044/http://www.docstoc.com/docs/21719483/Public-Offering-Registration---BRILLIANT-DIGITAL-ENTERTAINMENT-INC---9-17-1996 |date=21 January 2012 }} in 1996, focusing on 3D graphics streaming and compression for which it was granted 8 patents.{{cite web|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/US6538654?oq=brilliant+digital+animation |title=Patent 6538654 |access-date=20 December 2011}} BDE was the founding member of the Distributed Industry Computing Association.{{Cite web |url=http://www.dcia.info/awards/2007_DCIA_Founders_Award.pdf |title=Archived copy |access-date=20 December 2011 |archive-date=24 July 2007 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070724172435/http://dcia.info/awards/2007_DCIA_Founders_Award.pdf |url-status=dead }} The company developed a number of Internet interests including Altnet, a joint venture with Joltid Ltd.,{{Cite web|url=http://www.secinfo.com/d13nF9.286.d.htm|title=SEC Info - Brilliant Digital Entertainment Inc - '8-K' for 6/6/03 - EX-99|website=www.secinfo.com|access-date=2 May 2023}} to develop and market secure distributed storage for content using P2P technology to reduce distribution costs and reach new audiences. In 2003 Altnet, using its distributed storage technology, became the largest provider of secure DRM content, having distributed 75 million licensed files to users of various P2P file sharing software applications.{{cite web|url=http://news.cnet.com/Altnet-to-pay-Kazaa-users-for-swapping/2100-1025_3-1011827.html |title=Altnet To Pay Kazaa Users For Swapping |publisher=CNET News |access-date=20 December 2011}} Another initiative undertaken by Altnet under Bermeister's stewardship is Global File Registry,{{cite web |url=http://www.globalfileregistry.com/ |title=Home |website=globalfileregistry.com}} which enables governments and copyright owners to police the distribution of illegal or infringing material over distributed systems and the Internet. In 2006 BDE, Altnet and Kazaa settled major litigation with leading music and motion picture industry plaintiffs. Since then, Bermeister has focused on building and acquiring content, technology and distribution assets for BDE. During 2006, BDE was acquired by Kinetech Inc.,{{cite news|url=http://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20070416006161/en/Kinetech-Acquired-Brilliant-Digital-Entertainment-BDE|title=Kinetech Acquired Brilliant Digital Entertainment, BDE|work=Businesswire|date=16 April 2007}} a company with interests in patents and intellectual property licensing relating primarily to certain key distributed technologies that had been licensed by Altnet since 2002 and important to P2P storage and Global File Registry businesses of Altnet. Kinetech's patent and technology portfolio is often referred to as the True Name Patent Portfolio. In 2008, BDE acquired the Kazaa Trademark and relaunched Kazaa{{cite news |url=http://appscout.pcmag.com/music-entertainment/272066-kazaa-relaunches-as-licensed-service |title=Kazaa Relaunches as Licensed Service |publisher=PCMag |accessdate=20 December 2011 |first=Mark |last=Hachman}} with music licenses from major music labels Universal, Sony, Warner Music Group and EMI, major independent record labels, and leading music publishers. In 2011, BDE subsidiary Kinetech acquired a majority interest in PersonalWeb LLC [http://www.personalweb.com PersonalWeb],{{cite web |url=http://dmwmedia.com/news/2011/09/28/personalweb-melds-with-brilliant-digitals-kinetech |title=PersonalWeb Melds with Brilliant Digital's Kinetech |date=28 September 2011 |publisher=DigitalMediaWire |accessdate=20 December 2011}} a Tyler, Texas-based technology company. PersonalWeb develops its software based in part on the 13 pending and issued patents in the Truenames Patent Portfolio.{{Cite web|url=http://www.personalweb.com/Technology.html|title=PersonalWeb|website=www.personalweb.com|accessdate=2 May 2023}} ===Activity in Israel=== Bermeister is an active investor in Israeli real estate.{{cite news| url=https://www.latimes.com/world/la-xpm-2012-aug-31-la-fg-israel-bermeister-qa-20120901-story.html | work=Los Angeles Times | first=Edmund | last=Sanders | title=Investor Kevin Bermeister has big plans for Jerusalem, West Bank | date=31 August 2012}} In his latest real estate endeavours, he teamed with an Israeli retail magnate to bid for [[Nof Zion]], a major residential project in [[East Jerusalem]]{{cite web |url=https://www.jpost.com/NationalNews/Article.aspx?id=203344 |title=Nof Zion Residents Express Relief |work=The Jerusalem Post|accessdate=20 December 2011}} and he acquired a stake in The Leonardo Inn at the entrance to the city.{{cite web|last=Bermeister |first=Kevin |title=Hotel Expansion |url=http://www.hotelmanagement.net/transactions/kevin-bermeister-and-partners-acquire-leonardo-inn-hotel-jerusalem-for-175m-17288 |publisher=Hotel Management |accessdate=16 August 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130309055720/http://www.hotelmanagement.net/transactions/kevin-bermeister-and-partners-acquire-leonardo-inn-hotel-jerusalem-for-175m-17288 |archivedate= 9 March 2013 }} He is a founder of [http://www.jerusalem5800.com/ Jerusalem 5800], a long-term planning and research project for greater Jerusalem.{{cite web|last=Bermeister|first=Kevin|title=Founder Jerusalem 5800|url=http://www.jerusalem5800.com/about/}} ==Charity and sponsorship== Bermeister is a major benefactor and supporter of numerous charitable organisations including [[The Hunger Project]], [[United Israel Appeal]], [[Jewish Care]], [[UniOne Foundation]] and [[Jake's Ladder]], a foundation for research into [[cystic fibrosis]], The [[City of David (Silwan)|City of David]]{{dubious|The C.o.D. is not an enterprise, but a ruin-cum-Palestinian village. Maybe of Elad, the settlers' organisation running the C.o.D.?|date=October 2019}} and [[Binyan Adei Ad]]. He was recently awarded the [[Yeshiva Center]] Leadership in Philanthropy{{Cite web|url=http://www.shturem.org/index.php?section=news&id=23656|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130415213811/http://www.shturem.org/index.php?section=news&id=23656|url-status=dead|archive-date=15 April 2013|title=Welcome to My awesome site | My awesome site}} Award. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.brilliantdigital.com Brilliant Digital Entertainment] * [http://www.personalweb.com PersonalWeb] * [http://www.jerusalem5800.com Jerusalem 5800] {{DEFAULTSORT:Bermeister, Kevin}} [[Category:Australian businesspeople]] [[Category:Australian Jews]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:1960 births]]

Kevin Bermeister (born 1960 in South Africa) is an entrepreneur that has developed several businesses in the computer, multimedia and Internet industries.
He is a technology innovator, real estate investor, philanthropist, and the founder, chairman and CEO of Brilliant Digital Entertainment Inc. (BDE). Bermeister is a founding investor in a number of successful technology and real estate ventures including Skype.
